name: sepale
description: Sepale's source and its site: the components, the families, the theme generator. Published as @sepale/style and @sepale/components, from packages/ (ADR 0014).

scripts.build:css: node scripts/build-css.mjs && pnpm run gen:registry && pnpm run gen:components
scripts.build:css:public: node scripts/build-css.mjs --public && pnpm run gen:registry && pnpm run gen:components
scripts.prepare: svelte-kit sync && pnpm run gen:registry || echo ''
scripts.check: pnpm run build:css && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.package: pnpm run build:css:public && svelte-package -i src/lib -o packages/components/dist && node scripts/package.mjs
